definitions.explanation: The lower horizontal surface of a room on which one stands or walks.

examples.japanese: {床|ゆか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}って→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{床|ゆか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧しなければならない。
examples.english: I have to clean the floor.

examples.japanese: {床|ゆか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{滑|すべ}りやすい→滑りやすい：27611_suberiyasui⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつけて：01080_kiwotsukete⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful as the floor is slippery.

notes:
{床|ゆか} refers to the floor surface of a room — where you stand, walk, and sit.

KANJI READING:
The kanji {床|ゆか} has another reading とこ with different meanings:
- ⟦{床|とこ}の{間|ま}→床の間：05797_tokonoma⟧: tokonoma (decorative alcove in a Japanese room)
- {床|とこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧: to go to bed
- ⟦{床屋|とこや}→床屋：01682_tokoya⟧: barber shop

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {床|ゆか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃|は}く→掃く：04260_haku⟧: to sweep the floor
- {床|ゆか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧: to wipe/mop the floor
- {床|ゆか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧: to sit on the floor
- {床|ゆか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: to fall on the floor
- {床|ゆか}⟦{暖房|だんぼう}→暖房：01657_danbou⟧: floor heating

FLOOR TYPES:
- ⟦フローリング→フローリング：11125_furooringu⟧: wooden flooring
- ⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧: tatami mat flooring
- ⟦タイル→タイル：29719_tairu⟧: tile flooring
